name: Necromancer: Skeletal Artillery adds one or two Skeletal Archers to Animate: Skeletal Archer (#1831)
contract: Skeletal Artillery (CharacterAdvancement 7146, Animation tab, class 23) has two ranks: 302518 reads 'Your Animate: Skeletal Archers now summons $s1 additional Skeletal Archer.' and 302921 '... summons $s1 additional Skeletal Archers.' Both are passives in SpellFamilyName 29 whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), class mask (0, 0, 0x400000), with EffectBasePoints 0 (rank 1) and 1 (rank 2) + DieSides 1, so $s1 is 1 and 2. The mask selects only the summon helper 500330 (family flags 8, 0, 0x400000), not the parent 805040 (0x200008, 0, 0x802). Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 triggers 500330, whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of creature 50076 with EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3 ('Animate ${$500330m1} Skeletal Archers'), so the talent's modifier makes that effect 4 (rank 1) or 5 (rank 2). 500330 is bound to spell_ascension_necromancer_summon, which prevents the native summon and raised the fixed NecromancerSummons count of 3 whatever the modifiers said, so the talent summoned nothing extra. The count now applies the caster's effect modifiers for the summoning effect, as Spell::EffectSummonType does for the native effect value. A rank 1 Necromancer's cast must raise four archers and a rank 2 Necromancer's five; necromancer-audit-857-animate-skeletal-archer is the untalented control with three.

steps.label: Let the Life Force aura synchronize
SETUP: the rank 1 passive is active
SETUP: the rank 2 passive is active
Rank 1 raises the summon helper's effect value from 3 to 4
Rank 2 raises the summon helper's effect value from 3 to 5
SETUP: rank 1 has no archer before the cast
SETUP: rank 2 has no archer before the cast
The archers still occupy no Life Force: 2 free of 2
